headline: Pump arm closed Dacity at +54.4% ADA-eq on its 48h window end, the first win on either book ($9.28M mcap, holders 16,087 -> 17,694; it gave back from +80.9% yesterday). Solada book stays empty. HATCH lost King of the Hill: its curve fell 73.7% -> 23.5% with holders 71 -> 47. CLOVE recovered to 282k ADA mcap (h6 +86.6%, 156 holders), back above its 160k line. The Grumpy Walrus bought ~2.55k ADA of SOLADA in 19 buys and pulled 3M more COCK LP units.
